text:
sophia: quick sync — we need to lock the design partner cohort plan today. main open items: screening funnel, incentives, feedback cadence, and success metrics. thoughts?
ajay: agree. for screening I want a short tech-fit form + a 30m interview. screening form should capture model use-case, latency/SLO needs, and data sensitivity.
maria: +1. can we reuse the 5-question template from the pilot but add 'expected qps' and 'has internal eval suite? yes/no'
kevin: incentives — recommend $2k credit + 2 hours onboarding workshop per partner. keeps it simple and aligns with committed usage.
tom: curious on budget impact. do we have ~10 partners target? that'd be $20k credits + time. FYI legal wants DP agreement template reviewed for data handling.
sophia: target 8–12 partners. budget approved up to $25k credits for cohort. legal review on the agreement is in flight (pinging @emily).
emily: I have a draft NDA + DP addendum. will share by EOD. need to confirm whether logs are permitted for eval.
ajay: for feedback cadence propose: weekly async form + biweekly 1:1 calls during first 8 weeks, then monthly check-ins. also a shared Miro board for prompt/eval artifacts.
maria: add a lightweight quality checklist we can run: 1) latency within SLO for typical prompt 2) top-3 failure modes 3) sample output quality rating (1-5) across 50 examples.
kevin: success metrics we care about: avg token cost delta vs baseline, median p95 latency, and quality regression rate (percent prompts with lower than baseline score). recommend thresholds we can agree on per partner.
tom: on launch criteria — we shouldn't graduate partners until: no critical regressions in two consecutive weeks, usage >= commit floor for 2 weeks, and documentation + playbook validated by SE.
sophia: sounds good. one more ask: recruitment messaging. we should target roadmap-aligned partners: Retrieval-heavy search, customer support automation, and compliant healthcare ingest. short pitch doc?
ajay: I can draft the pitch: 1-pager problem statement, what we expect from partners, what they get. will include sample eval set asks.
emily: legal note: healthcare partners will need BAAs. that adds time; flagging for sales.
maria: screening form link (WIP): https://forms.internal/recruit-screening — suggest fields: company, point of contact, use-case, qps, data classification, onboarding window, commitment level.
kevin: also add a checkbox: willing to share anonymized eval prompts + outputs for quality monitoring. if no, we should move them to a lower-touch track.
sophia: excellent. for experiment design: we'll assign each partner a 'treatment' model variant and baseline variant, run A/B for 2 weeks with traffic split 80/20, measure quality + cost.
ajay: how do we handle fallbacks if a partner hits latency regressions? automated routing to fallback model + notify channel and partner. need to document the SLA hit remediation steps.
tom: ops will own the automated fallback config; we need runbooks. tagging @kevin for runbook ownership.
kevin: willing to own runbook. will draft failover steps and notification templates.
emily: I'll add the DP agreement term about telemetry retention and opt-in sharing.
sophia: ok action items: (1) ajay draft pitch + experiment plan by Tue, (2) maria finalize screening form + checklist by Mon, (3) emily share legal drafts by EOD, (4) kevin draft runbook & incentives flow by Wed, (5) tom sync ops for fallback + BAA timeline. I'll consolidate and share the outreach calendar.
ajay: noted. I'll also create a short recruiter blurb for community channels.
maria: can we include a small NPS-style question at week 4 and week 8 for partner sentiment? single line: "How satisfied are you with Redwood DP support? (0-10)"
sophia: yes include that. also track qualitative asks in the shared board.
dp-bot: reminder — design-partner-digest created with channels: #dp-cohort-1, #dp-cohort-1-ops at 1801122400
kevin: thanks bot.
sophia: perfect — if no objections I'll roll this into the onboarding checklist and push outreach tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
ajay: +1
emily: +1
maria: +1
tom: +1
kevin: +1
sophia: closing thread, will post the consolidated doc later.
